Draw a node-link panel

Source: R/seq_node_link.R
seq_node_link.Rd

Draws nodes, directed or plain edges and labelled group boxes at given positions. No layout is computed: x and y are used as supplied, in the track's x and y scales.

Usage

seq_node_link(
  nodes = NULL,
  edges = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  legend = NULL,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  legend_extra = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "canvas_margin",
  legend_side = "right",
  ...
)

Arguments

nodes, edges, groups

Data frames (or data tables) as described above.

aesthetics

A SeqAes. Recognised: node_mm (3), bar_linewidth (3), bar_alpha (0.35), arrow_mm (2), label_cex (0.6), edge_label_cex (0.55), box_r_mm (1), flag_color ("#D62728").

legend

NULL for one key per node shape present, FALSE for none, or a SeqLegendSpec or list of LegendKey used as given.

legend_labels

Named character vector relabelling the shape keys.

legend_extra

List of LegendKey appended to the keys.

show_legend

Logical. FALSE suppresses the legend.

legend_position, legend_side

Placement of the generated legend.

...

Unused.

Value

A SeqNodeLinkR6 instance. Add it to a track with a windows range and fixed scales.

Details

Columns of nodes: id, x, y (required), bar_lo, bar_hi (a translucent vertical bar), shape (circle, triangle_up, triangle_down, diamond or square; default circle), fill (default grey60), alpha (default 1), label.

Columns of edges: from, to (required node ids), arrow (default TRUE), color (default grey10), linetype (default 1), linewidth (default 1.4), label, flag (default FALSE; draws a marker at the edge midpoint).

Columns of groups: x, y, label (required), fill, color.

Examples

nodes <- data.frame(id = c("A", "B"), x = c(1, 2), y = c(0.2, 0.6))
edges <- data.frame(from = "A", to = "B", label = "fixed")
seq_node_link(nodes = nodes, edges = edges)
